images.title: Paint a day, count the hours
images.purpose: Shows a painted 48 box strip whose key turns each colour's box count into hours.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One strip of 48 boxes across the upper middle, painted in three colours, with a three line key centred below it.
images.exact_structure: A single row of 48 equal boxes with thin dark outlines. Boxes 1 to 14 and 45 to 48 filled teal (#0072B2), 18 boxes. Boxes 20 to 33 filled amber (#E69F00), 14 boxes. Boxes 15 to 19 and 34 to 44 filled green (#009E73), 16 boxes. Under the left end and under the right end: midnight. Below, a key of three rows, each with a small square of the colour: teal, sleep 18 = 9 hours; amber, school 14 = 7 hours; green, other 16 = 8 hours.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Count each colour's boxes and halve the count to get hours; the three add to 24 hours.
images.description: Shows a painted 48 box strip whose key turns each colour's box count into hours.
images.context: 18 + 14 + 16 = 48 boxes; 9 + 7 + 8 = 24 hours. Illustrative day for the tool.

image_decisions.why: A painted strip with a three colour key shows the practice's core move: count boxes, halve to get hours.
